abstracts: UNKNOWN — the artefact is identified and downloaded (the XX CCG 2025 agenda, 12pp) but its grid layout defeats a clean per-item count; see the counting plan in Method.
spot_checks: Located and downloaded the official programme: AgendaCCG2025-4.pdf (82,687,205 bytes, 12 pages, dated 14 Aug 2025), the last of five agenda revisions in the society's media library.

Programme geometry established: SEVEN parallel rooms (Gran Salón, Concepción, CañasGordas, Piedechinche, Pichichí, Mulaló, Los Ciruelos), each named three times, one per congress day; 66 time-slot rows across the three days, mostly 15-minute slots.

Three dedicated poster blocks exist and are listed in full in the same PDF: 'POSTERS MIÉRCOLES 13 DE AGOSTO', 'POSTERS JUEVES 14 DE AGOSTO' and 'POSTERS VIERNES 15 DE AGOSTO', preceded each day by an 'HORA EXCLUSIVA PÓSTERES' slot. Those blocks hold 908 non-blank text lines between them, each poster being a centred title of one to three lines followed by a centred author line.

NOT COUNTED because the count would not be honest: the oral programme is a seven-column grid with no per-item ID, and both pdftotext -layout and -raw interleave cells so that titles, authors and institutions cannot be attributed to a presentation without guessing. Rather than publish a number I cannot re-derive, the row is deferred with a plan.
cadence_evidence: Biennial. The society's own Memorias index (https://sociedadcolombianadegeologia.org/publicaciones/memorias_ccg) lists every edition: I 1969, II 1978, III 1981, IV 1982, V 1989, VI 1993, VII 1996, VIII 2001, IX 2003, X 2005, XI 2007, XII 2009, XIII 2011, XIV 2013, XV 2015, XVI 2017, XVII 2019, XVIII 2021, XIX 2023, XX 2025 — a clean two-year cycle since 2001 with no pandemic gap. 0.5.
character_evidence: Open call with published deadlines: proposals for special sessions and symposia 15 Jan - 31 Mar 2025 (extended to 15 Apr), abstracts 15 Jan - 31 Mar (extended to 21 Apr). The abstracts page states 'La recepción de resumenes de nuestro XX Congreso Colombiano de Geología ha sido un éxito. El Comité organizador del CCG ha recibido múltiples solicitudes para ampliar las fechas de recepción'. Seven parallel contributed rooms plus three poster days.
programme_evidence: AgendaCCG2025-4.pdf: main event 13-15 Aug 2025, courses and workshops 11-12 Aug, field trips separate.
method: Rung 3 attempted, ZERO searches, read in SPANISH. https://sociedadcolombianadegeologia.org/resumenes/ now 302s to /ccg2025/resumenesccg2025/. NEW ROUTE: the site is WordPress and its media API answers, but ONLY in the search form — https://sociedadcolombianadegeologia.org/wp-json/wp/v2/media?search=ccg2025&per_page=50&_fields=source_url,title returns the five agenda revisions, the two calls and the two circulars, none of which is linked from the visible programme page (which is an empty Divi shell). TRAP: adding mime_type=application/pdf to that query makes the endpoint return HTTP 400; page through per_page=100 without it and filter on the .pdf suffix yourself. The Memorias page (publicaciones/memorias_ccg) lists all twenty editions but renders each as a COVER IMAGE with no href, so the memorias volumes themselves are not reachable from it. NEEDS_BULK_COUNT — the plan, reproducible from this text: (1) take AgendaCCG2025-4.pdf; (2) for the POSTERS, split the -layout text at the three 'POSTERS <DAY> DE AGOSTO' headings and parse each block as repeating [title lines][author line], using the theme headings (which match the oral session names, e.g. 'SE Amb. Sed. Alta Res', 'Geofísica', '3º Simposio de Geoconservación y Patrimonio Geológico') as block separators; (3) for the ORALS, re-extract with pdftotext -bbox or a column-aware tool and assign each text box to one of the seven room columns by x-coordinate, counting one presentation per (slot, room) cell that carries a title; (4) exclude the ACTO INAGURAL, the plenary 'Conversatorio' and 'PANEL' cells in the Gran Salón column, the courses and workshops of 11-12 Aug and the field trips. A cleaner alternative if it appears: the 'Memorias CCG2025' volume, whose cover is already published at wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Portada-Memorias-CCG2025.png but whose PDF is not yet in the media library. VERDICT is BORDERLINE, not OUT: the seven-room, three-day grid plus three poster days is plainly a substantial programme and nothing found puts it under the bar.

abstracts: UNKNOWN — the presentation-level programme exists but is behind a JavaScript event portal that is now marked Closed. Session-level geometry says the meeting is large; see Method.
spot_checks: Identified the edition precisely: 'The 8th international Adaptation Futures Conference (AF2025) was held in Otautahi Christchurch, New Zealand from 13 to 16 October, 2025', hosted by the University of Canterbury; 'Adaptation Futures is the flagship event of the World Adaptation Science Programme (WASP)'.

Downloaded the official 91-page Provisional Scientific Programme (https://secure.tcc.co.nz/ei/images/AF25/AF2025_Programme.pdf, 1.47MB). It is a SESSION-level grid: up to SIXTEEN parallel named streams per time slot, four slots a day, across three conference days, plus theme plenaries and pre-conference events. It names sessions and stream titles but NOT individual presentations, so it cannot be counted per the census unit.

A session-level scale check from that grid: roughly sixteen parallel streams times four slots times three days is on the order of 190 session slots; at four to six presentations each that is well into four figures, but this is arithmetic on the grid, not a count, and I am not recording it as a figure.

The presentation-level artefacts are both unreachable. The 'Interactive Programme' is an EventsAir portal that returns a 6KB shell reading 'Closed' and 'You need to enable JavaScript to access this site'. The 'dedicated theme poster directory' linked from the poster page, https://adaptationfutures2025.com/uploads/images/Poster_Directory_251010.pdf, now returns HTTP 404 with an HTML error body (a .pdf URL serving text/html — the exact trap the field notes warn about; pdfinfo then fails with 'Couldn't find trailer dictionary').
cadence_evidence: Biennial. AF2025 Christchurch is the 8th conference in the series, stated on its own home page, and the 7th was Montreal in 2023. 0.5.
character_evidence: There is a real open call and a Scientific Program Committee with theme co-chairs, a poster programme with lunchtime poster conversations and a welcome-reception poster showcase, and journal publications arising from the conference. But the series is explicitly practitioner- and policy-facing — 'enables practitioners, policymakers, researchers, and academics from across the world to gather' — and the programme carries master classes, side events, Living Labs, a Climate Arts Outreach Programme, an Indigenous/First Nations/Oceans Talanoa and a plenary slate of government ministers and UN agency directors alongside the science streams.
method: Rungs 3-4 worked, ZERO searches, English. adaptationfutures2025.com is live and plain; adaptationfutures2027.org does not resolve. NEEDS_RUNG_5 — the exact page to open in a browser is https://tcc.eventsair.com/QuickEventWebsitePortal/adaptation-futures-conference-2025/programme/Agenda (the 'Interactive Programme'), which is the only artefact naming individual presentations. Two warnings for whoever opens it: the portal already reports itself 'Closed', so it may have been retired with the event and a Wayback capture may be the only route; and EventsAir agendas are virtualised lists, so per the methodology's rung-5 note, scroll in small steps and accumulate IDs into a Set rather than grabbing innerText once. A second, possibly easier target is the poster directory PDF, whose October 2025 filename was Poster_Directory_251010.pdf under https://adaptationfutures2025.com/uploads/images/ — the file has been removed but a newer build may exist; re-derive the filename from https://adaptationfutures2025.com/programme/poster-programme. VERDICT BORDERLINE, not OUT: nothing found puts this meeting under the bar, and its sixteen-stream grid argues strongly the other way.

abstracts: UNKNOWN — the 2026 convention site is a JavaScript SPA and its programme sits in an EventsAir portal; the society's own abstract archive stops long before this edition. See Method for the exact next action.
spot_checks: Edition identified: 'We were thrilled to present the Australian Earth Sciences Convention 2026 in Melbourne Victoria, Australia, 3-6 February 2026' (https://www.gsa.org.au/events/australian-earth-sciences-convention-aesc/), theme 'Geosciences: Solutions for the Future', at the Pullman Melbourne Albert Park, managed by ICMS Australasia.

The society's abstract archive was checked in full: https://www.gsa.org.au/publications/special-publications-and-abstracts/ lists about 100 GSA Abstracts volumes, every one of them an Issuu flipbook (issuu.com/gsaustralia/docs/abstract_NN_...). The most recent AESC volume in that archive is 'abstract_98 - aesc canberra july 2010'; the archive's own note says 'This archive is being progressively updated ... not all volumes are currently available in digital format'. So the route-hint's 'GSA Abstracts series' does not reach the recent editions, and the volumes that are there are flipbooks rather than countable PDFs.

The convention site https://aescgsa.com.au/ is a Next.js SPA: the whole HTML carries seven hrefs, all of them CSS/JS/favicon, and 53 characters of extractable text. Every content URL in the page belongs to the ICMS CDN (images) or to EventsAir forms (registration-form, fieldtrips-workshopsform, exhibition floorplan).
Guessed EventsAir programme paths return 404 or 500, so the portal path must be read off the live site rather than constructed.
cadence_evidence: Biennial, stated by the society: 'The Australian Earth Sciences Convention (AESC) is the flagship conference of the Geological Society of Australia (GSA). Held every two years...' (https://www.gsa.org.au/events/australian-earth-sciences-convention-aesc/). The current edition is Melbourne, 3-6 February 2026. 0.5.
character_evidence: The society's own description of the convention: 'Cutting-edge research across all disciplines of geoscience ... Poster sessions, exhibitions, and student events ... where students present alongside established leaders and where academia, industry, and government come together'. A named keynote slate is promoted separately on the convention site.
method: Rungs 3-4 attempted and blocked, 1 search ("AESC 2026" Australian Earth Sciences Convention Melbourne abstract book programme) used only to find the convention's own domain; no figure taken from any snippet. Domains that do NOT resolve: aesc2025.gsa.org.au, aesc2026.gsa.org.au, aesc2026.com.au, aesc2026.org, aesc.gsa.org.au. The live convention site is https://aescgsa.com.au/ (note the unguessable name). NEEDS_RUNG_5 — the exact next action: open https://aescgsa.com.au/ in a browser, follow its Program link into the ICMS EventsAir portal under https://icmsaust.eventsair.com/2026-australian-earth-sciences-convention-aesc-2026/ (the site's own EventsAir links use that base, e.g. /registration-form and /fieldtrips-workshopsform), and read the online programme or download the handbook; the portal is virtualised, so scroll in steps and accumulate presentation IDs into a Set. A second, independent target: the GSA Abstracts volume for AESC 2026, which will appear on https://www.gsa.org.au/publications/special-publications-and-abstracts/ as an Issuu flipbook under issuu.com/gsaustralia — Issuu exposes page text through its reader API, so a volume there is countable once it is posted. VERDICT BORDERLINE, not OUT: no evidence either way was found, and Australia's biennial national geoscience convention is not something to rule out on an empty search.
